key.name: enabled
key.description: Whether agents may use the desktop through Agent Access at all.

key.name: access-level
key.description: The most an agent may be granted: read-only, desktop, apps or screen-and-input, each including the ones before it.

key.name: remember-mode
key.description: ask: ask on an agent's first use in each session. remember: also offer Always allow, and let remembered agents in without asking.

key.name: notifications
key.description: Whether agents may read notification titles and bodies.

key.name: clipboard
key.description: Whether agents may read and set the clipboard.

key.name: confirm-sensitive
key.description: Whether the user is asked before every sensitive action of an agent.

key.name: allow-remote
key.description: Whether agents in remote login sessions (SSH) may use Agent Access.

key.name: excluded-apps
key.description: App ids agents may never read or control.

key.name: log-retention-days
key.description: Days the agent activity log keeps entries.
